changelog:
One Year, Source Public, Side-by-Side Overlays, Super Intelligent, System Bars, Spanish

One year since October 2025. Source now public under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0: copy and share with credit, no commercial use, no modified builds. C++ parts (echo cancellation, noise suppression, wake-word, voiceprint) remain private. Mods can be developed/sold separately per PLUGIN-EXCEPTION.md. Code in android directory of knoop7/Ava-Pro. Thanks @popy2k14, @CarlosTohe, @ds2000, @gilcu2, and community.

Side-by-side overlays: Floating layer control, off by default. Second full-screen overlay places beside current one at saved ratio. Landscape left-right 5:5, portrait top-bottom. Third overlay full screen. Screensaver always on top, never split. Music button and floating mini window not split. Cold start remembers first overlay, inserts second into split. Splittable layers: browser, weather, simple clock, Dream Clock, quick entities, voice messages, expanded media player. HA-controlled. System bars on same page, showable in HA. Split switch only from device. Path: Settings → App style → Floating layer control.

Super intelligent: real-time interruption in continuous conversation. Speak while reply playing or request processing, folded into current turn immediately. LLM decides turn end. Appears only with LLM engine and continuous conversation on. Without LLM: hot-word detection or question-mark follow-up. Button mode turns stay separate from wake-word continuous conversation. Thinking stays internal for tool calls, never spoken. Think toggle right of SSE, on by default. Path: Settings → Voice Config → Continuous Conversation → Super intelligent; Settings → Voice Config → Text to understanding → LLM language engine.

System bars: navigation bar visible for Back/Home/volume. Four levels: default hide (swipe edge), hide status bar only, hide both, visible. Overlays follow same level. Show in HA to switch from HA. Thanks @popy2k14 #236. Path: Settings → App style → System bars.

Sidebar Home: Home entry at sidebar bottom, swappable with Settings. On by default. Thanks @popy2k14 #239. Top-right button defaults to Settings, changeable to master service toggle. Top bar hideable. Long title scrolls horizontally. Hold title to drag. Path: Settings → Sidebar.

Pause other media: pauses Netflix/Emby/etc, not own player. Off by default. Button + media_key service published to HA. Button sends pause, service accepts pause/play/play_pause/stop/next/previous. Thanks @popy2k14 #242. Path: Settings → Android Intent Executor → Pause other media.

Voice button: finger movement while holding repositions button, does not end turn. Hold up to 2 min, HA 15s window auto-renews. Short speech pause does not end turn.

Square/older Android: short side under 680dp, pulled pages fill screen, handle not stretched. Square screens: music player portrait layout. Android 5-8: long-press overlay for Back, vinyl layer Back as round button. Encrypted MA pairing: see Fixes.

Alarms/scenes: "5 more minutes" counts from tap. One alarm left: Close keeps it, stops ringing. Reset scene replaced by timer_done #240 @popy2k14. New scenes: washing started/finished, dryer started/finished, hot-water warning, in DE/EN/ZH #243 @popy2k14.

Show after screen on: screensaver appears on screen on, page underneath stays. Touch/proximity wake keeps current page. Off by default. Thanks @popy2k14 #231. Path: Settings → Screensaver → Behavior & Wake.

Silent self-update: Shizuku/root/device owner installs without dialog. Device admin confirms once. Thanks @popy2k14 #232.

ESPHome version 2026.11.1 reported to HA (was 2026.10.1). Reconnect in HA for new version.

Fixes: New MA encrypted pairing (Noise handshake 25519_ChaChaPoly_SHA256, X25519 identity). Android 5-7.1 base64url line breaks/-_ rejection, own encoder. Android 7 JSON \/ escape, handshake over actual bytes. Noise frame not accepted: retries client/init, no plaintext fallback. Android 7-8 no usable ChaCha20-Poly1305: built-in RFC 8439. Android 9+ system implementation. Speech replaying: /api/tts_proxy/ no duration, retry counts as end after audio received, backward jump counts as end. Media player split: logo hidden, 20dp padding, cover no longer enlarges/overlaps. Dream Clock split: rounded corners removed. Home/Settings from split closes other overlays. Settings columns: square/portrait no two-column, landscape left list 10dp right. Real-time interruption: playback reference into echo cancellation, reply not mistaken for user. Model failover: 3 consecutive failures before slot switch, 401/403/404/400/unparseable count with wait. Caption line breaks: last line no longer 1-3 chars or lone period. Pull to refresh: pause at top before pulling. Voice button position: dock top/bottom/left/right. Cold-start caption layers off screen, no flash. Voice button: mic icon higher, caption wider, darker backing. Cold-start flash eliminated. Media player entity: original address, correct duration/progress, no loop on end. Speech/media separate. Reconnect in HA. LLM toolbar: small screen slots/SSE/Think shrink. Thinking never spoken. Square-screen cover: scaled centered. Android 7- underrun: pause flush play. Spanish interface. Thanks @CarlosTohe #234.

Issue fixes: #233 interface usable during self-update @popy2k14. #235 Android 10 Portal freeform thin window for mic @engfabiodario. #238 launch_intent independent of diagnostic sensor @popy2k14. #241 disabled mod no recreates manager @scenix222. #245 voice indicator off after proactive announcement @koshisan. #244 long replies not cut at 25s @Quadrapole.
